margin_angle_deg.source: IVO: Ivoclar Software Parameter Chart (exocad) Rev. 1, IPS e.max ZirCAD Prime (full/partial anatomical), single crown; docs/PHASE2.md §2.1; 'Crown margin angle' = slider Angle (DTX, EXW); acuan sudut masih interpretasi (PHASE2.md S4)

milling_tool_diameter_mm.source: IVO: Ivoclar Software Parameter Chart (exocad) Rev. 1, IPS e.max ZirCAD Prime (full/partial anatomical), single crown; docs/PHASE2.md §2.1; 'Anticipate milling: Yes, Diameter 1.2 mm'

blockout_free_zone_mm.source: tidak tercantum di IVO. Angka dari exocad Quick Guide: Crown Bottoms (transkrip video, arsip Wayback 2024-02-25 dari voicetube.com/videos/46150): "Don't block out zone near prepline" "The default value in our generic version is 0.1 mm"; 3-axis biasanya 0, 5-axis disarankan sama dengan cement gap. Default software, bukan angka material; bergantung konfigurasi milling yang belum ada di Fase 2 (docs/PHASE2.md §5.2)

milling_axes.source: isi dari mesin lab (3, 4, atau 5). Nilai 5 hanya isian sementara: Fase 2 belum punya mesin milling. 3/4 axis: block-out kedua sejajar sumbu setelah cement gap (exocad Quick Guide: Crown Bottoms, transkrip Wayback 2024-02-25: "For 3- or 4-axis production, material configurations typically define an additional block-out being applied after generating the cement gap"); 5 axis: undercut permukaan dalam hanya ditampilkan (docs/PHASE2.md §5.3)

occlusal_distance_mm.source: literatur: Nagata K dkk., "Verification of the accuracy and design time of crowns designed with artificial intelligence", J Adv Prosthodont 2025;17(1):1-10, doi:10.4047/jap.2025.17.1.1 (PMC11886404; teks lengkap dibaca lewat Europe PMC 2026-10-25): "The design parameters were set as follows: ... occlusal distance, 0 µm; approximal distance, −20 µm". Setelan desain studi in vitro (3Shape Dental System dan Dentbird), berdasarkan Cho dkk.; bukan rekomendasi klinis. Isi dengan praktik lab (docs/PHASE2.md §5.4)

approximal_distance_mm.source: literatur: Nagata K dkk., "Verification of the accuracy and design time of crowns designed with artificial intelligence", J Adv Prosthodont 2025;17(1):1-10, doi:10.4047/jap.2025.17.1.1 (PMC11886404; teks lengkap dibaca lewat Europe PMC 2026-10-25): "The design parameters were set as follows: ... occlusal distance, 0 µm; approximal distance, −20 µm". Setelan desain studi in vitro (3Shape Dental System dan Dentbird), berdasarkan Cho dkk.; bukan rekomendasi klinis. Isi dengan praktik lab (docs/PHASE2.md §5.4)

emergence_angle_deg.source: literatur: Monaco C, Silvestri D, Felice TD, Arena A, Bonvicini M, Di Fiore A, Zicari F. "A New Digital Technique to Analyze the Inclination of Tooth Emergence Profile and Distance from the Bone Crest to the Cementoenamel Junction", Int J Prosthodont 2026;39(1):37-45, doi:10.11607/ijp.9272, PMID 40388572 (abstrak dibaca di Europe PMC dan Quintessence 2026-10-25): "an increase in emergence profile angle from an average value of 13 to 19 degrees when simulating prosthetic chamfer preparation". CBCT 57 gigi; acuan sudut tidak disebut di abstrak (teks lengkap berbayar, belum dibaca). Di sini diukur terhadap sumbu insersi pada sepertiga servikal crown (docs/PHASE2.md §5.4)
